meaning:
οἴομαι, οἶμαι
[in LXX for הִנֵּה, Gen.37:7, al. ;]
to suppose, expect, imagine; with accusative and inf., Jhn.21:25; with inf., Php.1:17; before ὅτι, Jas.1:7.†
οἶμαι, see: οἴομαι
SYN.. see: ἡγέομαι (AS)

elsewhere.note: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books…
For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
